label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar, which is derived from user-provided parameter. The code does not sanitize or encode the input before writing it to the response using toCharArray(...). The X-XSS-Protection header is set to 0, disabling browser-based protections. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User-provided value is obtained via request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest00392") and assigned to param.
The unsanitized bar variable is written directly to the HTTP response using toCharArray(...), creating an XSS vulnerability.
